title: Turn down the brightness on the new dark mode for web
summary: @samuelclay I see the web version got an update to dark mode recently. It went from having a dark gray background with off-white/light gray text to now a dark blue background with bright white text. This new change in contrast is hurting my eyes. Can you switch it back to the old dark mode, or maybe give us the option to customize a mode beyond just light/dark? Thanks. pk

I see the web version got an update to dark mode recently. It went from having a dark gray background with off-white/light gray text to now a dark blue background with bright white text. This new change in contrast is hurting my eyes. Can you switch it back to the old dark mode, or maybe give us the option to customize a mode beyond just light/dark? Thanks.

Samuel,


Thank you for the speedy reply. The text is objectively brighter now, which is my primary complaint. I also think the new blue background is darker than the old gray, adding to the increase in contrast which is straining my eyes.


I personally prefer the old gray background as well, but that is subjective. I don’t agree with your assessment that the rest of the dark mode is “a whole lot better”, but your are certainly entitled to your opinion.


Could we maybe meet in the middle? Keep the “light mode”, your new “dark mode”, and revive the old dark theme as a new “gray mode”? You could keep just light and dark in the rotation for “auto mode”.


I appreciate you responding to user feedback. I’ve been using this platform for a very long time, and have enjoyed it thoroughly. I don’t usually react well to change, even those that seem like they are for the better. I understand the dilemma as a developer. Once you have enough users, even a little change will rattle at least one person. It can be hard to keep everyone happy. Thank you for all of your hard work.


pk

Yeah, it would be nice to have a gray mode option, sort of like we have on iOS and Android. I’ll get that in. It won’t be a perfect reversion to what we had before, but it’ll be pretty close. I think what we’ll do is increase the grays a little bit, so we decrease the contrast. I’ll also introduce a Sepia theme as well.
